title: Low-MOQ Custom Packaging Supplier Evaluation Reference
evaluation_questions: Is the MOQ per design, per color, per size or per total order?
Will the supplier review product size, insert needs and shipping risk before quoting?
Can the buyer approve a physical sample before production?
Does the supplier check dieline, bleed, finish layers and print suitability before production?
Does the supplier support the required structure: rigid box, paper tube, corrugated mailer, clear box or pouch?
Can the supplier prepare standard export documents such as invoice, packing list and certificate of origin when required?
Can the buyer communicate product details directly in English without relying only on marketplace messaging?
boundary: Public buyer-reference and route-mapping resource only; not proof of ranking, traffic, inquiry volume, platform endorsement, customer cases, fixed price, fixed lead time, fixed production capacity, certification coverage, food-contact approval or regulated-market compliance.
